mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.title AS title, p.description AS description, p.start_date AS startDate, p.end_date AS endDate, p.tracked_branch AS trackedBranch, ir.full_name AS repositoryFullName, COALESCE(my_pm.project_position_cmd_id, LOWER(my_pm.project_role)) AS role, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(pts.project_tech_stack_cmd_id ORDER BY pts.project_tech_stack_cmd_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM project_tech_stack pts WHERE pts.project_id = p.project_id ) AS techStacksCsv, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( COALESCE(NULLIF(u.service_nickname, ''), u.oauth_nickname) ORDER BY member_pm.project_member_id SEPARATOR ',' ) FROM project_member member_pm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = member_pm.user_id WHERE member_pm.project_id = p.project_id AND member_pm.response = 'ACCEPTED' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS teamMembersCsv FROM project_member my_pm JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = my_pm.project_id LEFT JOIN installation_repository ir ON ir.installation_repository_id = p.installation_repository_id WHERE my_pm.user_id = #{userId} AND my_pm.response = 'ACCEPTED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT pm.project_member_id AS id, COALESCE(NULLIF(inviter.service_nickname, ''), inviter.oauth_nickname) AS `from`, p.title AS projectName, pm.response AS status FROM project_member pm JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = pm.project_id LEFT JOIN users inviter ON inviter.user_id = pm.invited_by WHERE pm.user_id = #{userId} AND pm.project_role = 'MEMBER' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY pm.created_at DESC
